settings.headline: Start, stop, or transfer service
settings.subtitle: Moving into Carrow Bend, moving out, or putting a rental in a tenant's name — what the district needs, and how far ahead to ask.

settings.headline: Start service
settings.body:
Ask two business days ahead (story). The district needs the service address, move-in date, a name for the account, and whether the meter can be reached without a gate code.

Deposits, if any, are in the table below — no surprise amount at the door. First bill is prorated and shows the read the account started from.
settings.side: Give a forwarding address and a stop date; the final read happens that morning in the story workflow. For rentals, landlords can hold a revert-to-owner agreement so water is not shut off between tenants.

settings.headline: Deposits & connection (story)
settings.intro: Story amounts for this fictional district.

items.b: Waived with a letter of credit from a prior utility, story rule
